name: Light Domain
summary: Clerics of sun and fire who burn away darkness.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.short: Extra spells that are always prepared.
features.summary: You always have your domain spells prepared once you reach the listed cleric levels. They don't count against the number of spells you prepare each day.

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.summary: You gain the Light cantrip if you don't already know it.

features.name: Warding Flare
features.short: Reaction: impose disadvantage on an attack against you.
features.summary: When a creature within 30 ft. attacks you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll with a flash of light (creatures that can't be blinded are immune). Uses: WIS modifier per long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
features.short: Dispel magical darkness; 2d10 + level radiant in 30 ft.
features.summary: As an action, dispel magical darkness within 30 ft. Each hostile creature within 30 ft. makes a CON save, taking 2d10 + your cleric level radiant damage on a failure, half on a success.

features.name: Improved Flare
features.short: Warding Flare can protect allies too.
features.summary: You can use Warding Flare when a creature within 30 ft. attacks a creature other than you.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.short: Add WIS to cleric cantrip damage.
features.summary: You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

features.name: Corona of Light
features.short: Bright aura: enemies have disadvantage against fire and radiant spells.
features.summary: As an action, you emit bright light in a 60 ft. radius for 1 minute. Enemies in it have disadvantage on saves against spells that deal fire or radiant damage.
